primary_hypothesis: On matched full-parameter warm starts and identical verified RU/EN/code examples, completion-only loss improves free-generation correct answers versus full-sequence language modelling; a loss decrease alone is not success.
base: G1 step192 BF16 rounded weights upcast to FP32
batching: uniform family/language bucket then four sampled examples; identical sequence of batch IDs across arms
generation: greedy unrestricted 8192-token vocabulary; max_new_tokens=8; EOS stop
safety: no network or generated code execution in training/evaluation
notes: Verified synthetic cases are not broad reasoning benchmarks.
One seed per trained arm; no population-level architecture conclusion.
Goal intelligence first; long context/encyclopedic memory can be a separate tradeoff.
